title: raise for same-named param mixed between expanding contexts

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/discussions/8017

```py
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, select, bindparam, literal


e = create_engine("sqlite://", echo='debug')

with e.connect() as conn:
    r1 = conn.execute(
        select(
            literal("x").in_(bindparam('q')),
            literal("x").in_(bindparam('q')),
        ),
        {"q": ["a", "x"]}
    )
    assert r1.first() == (True, True)


    r1 = conn.execute(
        select(
            literal("x").in_(bindparam('q')),
            bindparam('q'),
        ),
        {"q": ["a", "x"]}
    )
    assert r1.first() == (True, True)
```

the second statement wouldn't work anyway, but we get a key error:

```py
 File "/home/classic/dev/sqlalchemy/lib/sqlalchemy/engine/base.py", line 1691, in _execute_context
    context = constructor(
  File "/home/classic/dev/sqlalchemy/lib/sqlalchemy/engine/default.py", line 953, in _init_compiled
    expanded_state = compiled._process_parameters_for_postcompile(
  File "/home/classic/dev/sqlalchemy/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py", line 1483, in _process_parameters_for_postcompile
    statement = re.sub(
  File "/opt/python-3.10.0/lib/python3.10/re.py", line 209, in sub
    return _compile(pattern, flags).sub(repl, string, count)
  File "/home/classic/dev/sqlalchemy/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py", line 1470, in process_expanding
    expr = replacement_expressions[key]
sqlalchemy.exc.StatementError: (builtins.KeyError) 'q'
[SQL: SELECT ? IN (__[POSTCOMPILE_q]) AS anon_1, ? AS anon_2]
[parameters: [{'q': ['a', 'x']}]]

```

patch:

```diff
diff --git a/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py b/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py
index f774028f22..995cee44a2 100644
--- a/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py
+++ b/lib/sqlalchemy/sql/compiler.py
@@ -2860,6 +2860,13 @@ class SQLCompiler(Compiled):
                         "Bind parameter '%s' conflicts with "
                         "unique bind parameter of the same name" % name
                     )
+                elif existing.expanding != bindparam.expanding:
+                    raise exc.CompileError(
+                        "Can't reuse bound parameter name %s in both "
+                        "'expanding' (e.g. within an IN expression) and "
+                        "non-expanding contexts"
+                        % (name,)
+                    )
                 elif existing._is_crud or bindparam._is_crud:
                     if existing._is_crud and bindparam._is_crud:
                         # TODO: this condition is not well understood.

```
